title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Auditorium on 1973-02-17

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture delivers a high‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Here Comes Sunshine → China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider transition.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard mix that’s generally clear and well‑balanced, with only occasional vocal distortion and brief technical glitches. Musically the night shines thanks to the flawless HCS‑China‑Rider trio and an energetic Bird Song, though the set suffers from missing half of the first set and uneven vocals on several numbers.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and soundboard quality (average rating ~3.5, many 4‑5 stars), but a few note vocal problems, missing portions of the first set, and occasional mix issues, pulling the overall score to a solid “good” range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and well‑balanced; a few moments of distortion on vocals and minor technical glitches in "Promised Land" and "He's Gone" are noted, but the overall mix is praised as near‑perfect.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The early part of the show is strong, especially the HCS‑China‑Rider trio, but roughly half of the first set is missing and the second set lacks big jams, leaving the concert feeling a bit unfinished.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for leading the iconic transition, ripping solos, and delivering an excellent guitar tone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Criticized for sub‑par vocal delivery on "You Ain't Woman Enough" and uneven rhythm guitar on songs like "Not Fade Away" and "One More Saturday Night".
